Stacking Fault Energy Calculator

Wei Xiong and Xinhang Shi Physical Metallurgy and Materials Design Laboratory, University of Pittsburgh

Enter an alloy composition and a temperature, or load a spreadsheet of them. You get an estimated stacking fault energy, the uncertainty range the true value is likely to fall in, and a warning if the alloy sits outside the composition and temperature limits of the training data.

The model is trained on the dataset reported in: Xin Wang and Wei Xiong, “Stacking fault energy prediction for austenitic steels: thermodynamic modeling vs. machine learning,” Science and Technology of Advanced Materials 21:1 (2020) 626–634. Please cite this work when you use the predictor.
https://doi.org/10.1080/14686996.2020.1808433
